description.narrative: The project will provide financing to construct a 300 megawatt (MW) run-of-river hydro power plant located on the Kunhar river in Mansehra District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KBK) province of Pakistan. The project will (i) improve energy security by increasing the clean energy share in the country's energy mix currently dominated by thermal power generation, (ii) boost provincial economy and promote revenue generating investments in the hydro abundant province of KPK, and (iii) build capacity and awareness on climate change impacts, adaptation and mitigation measures. The project also targets to improve the quality of life for women in communities surrounding the project area and promotes gender mainstreaming.

Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: PEDO's revenues from indigenous resources increased Indicator: 300 MW hydropower plant connected to national grid Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The revised schedule will be agreed upon following the finalization of the main E&M equipment supply. Data Source: PEDO bi-annual project progress report

Output: Capacity for climate change risk management in hydropower production enhanced Indicator: Knowledge of at least 30 PEDO staff (including at least 50% of PEDO's female staff) enhanced on climate change impact mitigation and adaption for hydropower projects through trainings and capacity building Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Target revised from 2023 to 2025 after MTR in Oct 2024.
NGO trained 15 PEDO officials in Q4 2023. Second training to be held in 2026.
PMC commenced services on 18 Sep 2020 to support this output. PEDO submitted the PMC's training needs assessment prepared by PMC to ADB on 20 June 2024. ADB gave comments on 15 Aug 2024. PEDO submitted revised assessment to ADB on 24 Sep, and ADB accepted on 8 Oct 2024. PMC's trainings will run from Oct 2025 to March 2026. Data Source: PEDO bi-annual project progress report

Output: Climate-resilient hydropower plant commissioned Indicator: 300-MW hydropower plant commissioned in Balakot, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, incorporating seismic strengthening and climate-proofing measures Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Target still feasible with possible loan extension. As of Dec 2025, physical progress is 26% vs planned progress of 78%.
EPC contract declared effective on 27 Sep 2021. ADB gave no objection to handover 4 mouzas in Dec 2022 and March 2023. Basic design completed. Detailed design commenced in Q2 2023. Works commenced in Q1 2023 in areas that do not require displacement of affected persons.
Land acquisition compensation almost completed, and works being expedited. Additional compensation, as per the independent valuation study (IVS), approved by the Provincial Cabinet in its meeting on 23 April 2024. LARP addendums based on IVS approved in Aug 2024.
Subcontract with main E&M equipment supplier signed, and advance payment made in Oct 2025. EPC contractor to provide revised schedule. Data Source: Operational acceptance certificate

Output: Income-earning opportunities and skills for local communities increased Indicator: 500 community members (with 50% women participation) livelihood skills development improved Achievement: 478 Progress/Status: Ongoing. NGO will conduct training based on livelihood restoration plan (LRP, output 1b). The training will run from Oct 2025 to Q3 2026.
Data Source: PEDO bi-annual project progress report

Output: Income-earning opportunities and skills for local communities increased Indicator: 500 local employment in construction related work generated Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 1,471 locals (605 skilled, 866 unskilled) employed in different job positions as of 31 Aug 2025. NGO launched 50% of the campaign in Q1 2025 for only women and girls (goal of at least 30% women and girls exceeded). The remaining 50% of the campaign will be rolled out in 2026. Output: Capacity for climate change risk management in hydropower production enhanced Indicator: Climate change risk guidelines in PEDO standard operating procedure for hydropower projects incorporated Achievement: N Progress/Status: Target revised from 2023 to 2025 after MTR.
The independent climate change expert drafted climate change risk guidelines. PEDO provided their comments on the guidelines in Aug 2025. NGO will submit the revised guidelines to PEDO for approval.
